title: Jebel-Quant Fleet
description: State of every Jebel-Quant repo: template drift, CI on the default branch, open pull requests, and the working copies on this machine.

panels.title: Open PRs
panels.description: Open pull requests across the fleet, counted before any per-repo clipping.

panels.title: Open issues
panels.description: Open issues across the fleet, excluding pull requests - GitHub's own open_issues_count lumps the two together, so PRs are subtracted out.

panels.title: CI red on main
panels.description: Repos whose last completed run on the default branch did not pass.

links.title: Show the repos behind this number

panels.title: Behind template
panels.description: Repos pinned to a template release older than the newest one.

links.title: Show the repos behind this number
Show the repos behind this number

panels.title: Local repos not in sync
panels.description: Clones whose default-branch commit differs from the one GitHub reports - almost always a checkout that has not been pulled. Needs no fetch to compute, so unlike Ahead/Behind it is never stale.

links.title: Show the repos behind this number

panels.title: Dirty working copies
panels.description: Local clones with uncommitted changes to tracked files.

links.title: Show the repos behind this number

panels.title: Clones off default branch
panels.description: A branch checked out and left behind - the usual residue of a parallel session.

links.title: Show the repos behind this number

panels.title: Data age
panels.description: How long since the collector last refreshed, worst of its two sources. This machine's Docker pauses when the Mac sleeps, so nothing is collected then - an amber or red value here means the numbers above are from before the last sleep, and panels can read 'No data' entirely once the gap passes Prometheus's 5-minute staleness window.

panels.title: Open problems by kind
panels.description: How many repos are in each bad state over time. Three distinct kinds, so the colours carry identity, not severity.

panels.title: CI on the default branch, per repo
panels.description: One row per repo; green means the last completed run on the default branch passed. Owner prefixes are stripped for legibility - repo names are unique across the monitored orgs. Gaps are windows where the collector was not running.

panels.title: Template releases behind
panels.description: How many releases were published after each repo's pinned ref. Repos pinned to a branch or a sha are absent - the pin is not comparable to a release.

panels.title: Last completed run on the default branch

targets.expr: (time() - jq_pull_request_created_timestamp_seconds{repo=~"$repo"}) * on(repo, number) group_left(title, author, checks, draft) topk by (repo, number) (1, jq_pull_request_info{repo=~"$repo"})

Open this pull request on GitHub
Open the repo's pull requests on GitHub

panels.title: Local working copies
panels.description: Ahead and behind are as of each clone's last fetch - read them next to the fetch age. 'In sync' compares the local default-branch commit with the one GitHub reports and needs no fetch. 'Checkout ref' is the template ref pinned in *this clone*, which can lag the repo's own ref shown under Template drift.

panels.title: Failing workflows on the default branch
panels.description: One row per failing workflow, not per repo - a repo can have more than one red workflow, so this list can be longer than the 'CI red on main' tile, which counts repos.

panels.title: Repos behind the template
panels.description: Every repo pinned to an older template release. Matches the 'Behind template' tile.

panels.title: Working copies with uncommitted changes
panels.description: Matches the 'Dirty working copies' tile. Counts tracked files only; untracked files are in the main table.

panels.title: Open pull requests with red checks
panels.description: Matches the 'PRs with red checks' tile.

targets.expr: (time() - jq_pull_request_created_timestamp_seconds{repo=~"$repo"}) * on(repo, number) group_left(title, author, checks) topk by (repo, number) (1, jq_pull_request_info{repo=~"$repo", checks=~"failure|cancelled"})

value.title: Open the repo's pull requests on GitHub
Open this pull request on GitHub
Open this pull request on GitHub

panels.title: Clones parked off their default branch
panels.description: Matches the 'Clones off default branch' tile. The value column is omitted - the branch name is the point.

panels.title: Local clones not in sync with GitHub
panels.description: The local default-branch commit differs from GitHub's. Sorted stalest fetch first - a plain `git pull` clears almost all of these.

targets.expr: (jq_local_fetch_age_seconds{repo=~"$repo"} and on(repo) (jq_local_default_branch_synced{repo=~"$repo"} == 0)) * on(repo) group_left(branch) topk by (repo) (1, jq_local_branch_info{repo=~"$repo"})

panels.title: Open issues by repo
panels.description: Repos with at least one open issue, pull requests excluded.
